verdict.rationale: Kling's own site advertises "MCP / CLI: Let Your Agent Power Kling," a first-party claim that external agents can drive Kling through MCP. That makes the official MCP server axis applicable and nominally supported, but the evidence is a single marketing line with no setup or usage detail. missing for 10: MCP server setup/connection documentation, endpoint or package details, list of exposed tools, authentication guidance for MCP clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.
